exposure: Magnesium sulfate alone vs. magnesium sulfate combined with nifedipine
outcome: Treatment efficacy for pregnancy-induced hypertension syndrome (PIHS)
finding: Magnesium sulfate combined with nifedipine showed higher efficacy in treating PIHS, lowering blood pressure, improving glucose and lipid metabolism, and reducing cesarean section and postpartum hemorrhage rates compared to magnesium sulfate alone.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight (not significantly different between groups)
